## Fixed
- **Kick followers no longer show "Error".** Kick sends the follower count sometimes as a number and sometimes as text; the bar now reads both, so it stops alternating between the value and "· Error". The same applies to Kick viewers and to the Kick chat used by comments goals.

## What's new
- **Support message.** A "☕ Is it useful? Buy me a coffee" button at the end of the Goal Bar properties opens a short message with a link to Ko-fi. It only opens when you click it: never on its own, and nothing is stored.
- The update menu and dialog now say **AC Goal Bar**.

## Updating
From 0.1.1 on, AC Goal Bar offers this update automatically (or use **Tools → Goal Bar: Check for updates**; from this version on the menu says **AC Goal Bar: Check for updates**). From 0.1.0, replace the plugin folder by hand once.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | Install to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon, 13+) | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.6-macos-arm64.zip` | `~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/` |
| Windows x64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.6-windows-x64.zip` | `C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\` |
| Linux x86_64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.6-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/` |

The macOS bundle is ad-hoc signed; if macOS blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the installed `.plugin` (see README).

All three packages are built and unit-tested in CI from the same commit.
